test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - Quant (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The data given below shows the marks scored by 5 different students in two different subjects.
Marks scored in Science: 64, 72, 55, 90, 47
Marks scored in Mathematics: 35, 66, 94, 80, 48
Find the difference between the median marks scored in Science and the mean marks scored in Mathematics.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Median Science: Sort marks {47, 55, 64, 72, 90} → Middle value (3rd) = 64.

Mean Math: (35 + 66 + 94 + 80 + 48) ÷ 5 = 323 ÷ 5 = 64.6.

Required Difference = 64.6 − 64 = 0.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marks in Science: 64, 72, 55, 90, 47

Marks in Mathematics: 35, 66, 94, 80, 48

**Formula Used:**

Median (for odd n) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)rd term of the sorted data.

Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

**Calculations:**

⇒ Arrange Science marks in ascending order: 47, 55, 64, 72, 90.

⇒ Number of students (n) = 5.

⇒ Median Science = ((5 + 1) ÷ 2)rd term = 3rd term = 64.

⇒ Sum of Mathematics marks = 35 + 66 + 94 + 80 + 48 = 323.

⇒ Mean Mathematics = 323 ÷ 5 = 64.6.

⇒ Difference = Mean (Math) − Median (Science)

⇒ Difference = 64.6 − 64 = 0.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

The sum of all values in a dataset divided by the total number of values: Mean (μ) = Σx ÷ n.

Median for Even n

If the number of terms (n) is even, the median is the average of the (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms after sorting.

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean.</p
